title: Architecture map
description: The checked-in description of a system's nodes, bindings, views and exclusions. See docs/vibecheck-spec.md.

solution.description: The solution file, relative to the repository root.

exclude.description: Type patterns naming the types that are not part of the system. An excluded type is not partitioned and creates no edges.

tests.description: Type patterns naming the test types. A test type binds to nothing and creates no edges, but the analysis keeps it as evidence about the system. A type that exclude also matches is excluded. See docs/tests.md section 3.1.

patterns.description: Entries that name, declare or ignore the patterns a review finds among the types. See docs/patterns.md section 4.4.

category.description: The broad category of the node's role. A node without one takes its nearest ancestor's.

bind.description: Patterns over fully qualified type names, with * (no dots) and ** (any) wildcards and an optional Assembly:: qualifier. Present on leaves only.

key.description: A trait that types share: inherits:, implements: or attribute: and the open name of a type, such as implements:MassTransit.IConsumer<>, or suffix: and the text a type's name ends with.

keys.description: The keys every instance carries. The entry names the pattern discovery finds with these keys, or declares it.

ignore.description: A key whose group discovery drops, such as a marker interface every message carries.

level.description: root or a container identifier. The view's groups partition the leaves under it.

bind.description: Assembly name patterns, with * as a wildcard.
